entries.appendix: new: the script that cuts the session; Windows runs the native helper (fixture_helper), which ends the server's session processes by exact id
new: the close script's release file; relative to the fixture directory on Windows
new: the server forces the close script itself on Windows
new: the close script is written where the Windows session sources it
new: a connect through Windows' sshd.exe takes about 200 ms more

new | owed Windows porting work (operator, 2026-10-11: not platform); step 1.5, run winp1c 2026-10-11: a native helper that closed every handle to the output pipes in every process that held one got no EOF from Windows sshd.exe until the session's process exited, when EOF, exit status and CHANNEL_CLOSE arrived together, so no server process can end a channel's output and keep the channel open; needs a server the test controls at the protocol level, or an operator decision
